title: Share on a video gives the link to its page
change: Share on a video card opens the same Share dialog a page card opens, with the link to the page that video sits on. It no longer creates a new page and drops the rep in the editor.
evidence: Share meant three things, and on a video card it created a new Journey Page and opened the editor (walkthrough friction point 6, rated high).
notes: The dialog is the real page Share dialog. The row that names the page, with a thumbnail of it, is new. A video that has no page yet needs its own state, not shown here.
